voice.summary: Calm, useful and specific. Say what is happening, where, when and what it costs, then point to the page. Second person is fine. Plain Canadian English.
examples: Hillhurst Sunnyside Farmers' Market is on this Wednesday, 3 to 7 pm at 1320 5 Ave NW. Year-round, run by the community association. Dates and vendors on calgarywatch.ca/markets.
Free this weekend: Held. Together. at Nickle Galleries, UCalgary. Open 9 to 4 through Friday. Details and the organizer's page at the link in bio.
Five things on this weekend in Calgary, all with dates checked against the organizer's own page.
rules: Use only facts supplied with the listing. Never invent prices, times, performers, crowds or quotes.
Name the source organization when it adds trust (for example 'listed by University of Calgary').
No superlatives about businesses ('best', 'top', '#1') unless the line is labelled as a CalgaryWatch pick and was never paid for.
Never write incident, crime or emergency posts as lifestyle or entertainment content.
Paid placements always say 'Featured partner' in the image and the first line of the caption.
At most 5 hashtags. Prefer #yyc #calgary plus 1 to 3 specific tags.
